purpose: Reciprocal source-to-premise coverage ledger for the frozen solver-premise-map v1. This does not mutate v1; it records whether source strata independently rediscover, extend, or escape the map.

batches.selectionRule: Current authorities governing inference, evaluation, and solver research method, selected without using premise IDs or graph thinness.

sources.notes: Exposed causal-ancestry/pseudoreplication, claim-propagation drift, and general rival-explanation discriminability as concepts not cleanly isolated in v1.
Separates runtime/sample/distributional independence, treats dependent rediscoveries as non-independent support, and makes confirmation evidence consumable for descendants.
Strong convergence with v1; remaining novelty is in independence/ancestry/evidence-lifecycle/discriminability parent semantics.

batches.result: Material novelty found. Research-evidence process was underrepresented relative to search mechanics.

batches.stratum: runtime lifecycle, continuation, and budget semantics
batches.selectionRule: Current execution contracts for continuation and deterministic allocation, selected as runtime surfaces rather than premise-map neighbors.

sources.notes: Continuation ownership, censoring, policy-switch and handoff semantics are already represented at adequate parent/specialization levels.
Base-vs-total budget, deterministic currency, deadline censoring and finite-envelope displacement converge with existing premises.

batches.result: Strong saturation signal from a heterogeneous runtime-contract batch.

batches.stratum: human/editor family construction and clustered evidence
batches.selectionRule: A data-generation resource with different ancestry from synthetic stress generators, selected to probe distribution and independent-unit assumptions.

sources.notes: Confirms that descendant-row count and independent-parent count are distinct and that human-origin evidence is only one claim-relative distributional axis.

batches.result: No additional parent beyond B001 candidates; cross-stratum independent support for PV1-001/PV1-002.

batches.stratum: generator, corpus, and variant-family evidence semantics
batches.selectionRule: Durable contracts for bulk variant families and stress-corpus construction/selection, chosen to test distribution, transformation, and independence assumptions.

sources.notes: Strongly reinforces clustered independence and consumable holdout status. It also exposes full-search transformation equivariance as a specialization not cleanly isolated by v1 symmetry/canonicalization premises.
Mixed corpus ancestry, solver-outcome selection, generator support boundaries, construction-witness conditioning and cross-distribution limits are already represented.

batches.result: Distribution semantics largely saturated; one bounded transformation-equivariance specialization added as a candidate.

batches.selectionRule: Current archaeology authority sampled from its method and major unresolved historical families, including pre-current vocabulary and dirty/unfinished treatment chains.

sources.notes: Historical vocabulary drift, dirty reverts, silent treatment non-participation, unfinished experiment chains, dead tooling and changed architecture are already explicit premise-map territory. No new parent emerged from the sampled historical families.

batches.result: Strong saturation signal from the historical stratum; the prior archaeology-based passes appear to have covered its major conceptual payload.

batches.stratum: runtime code defaults and lifecycle implementation
batches.selectionRule: Implementation map plus representative stage-eligibility and mutable-search-state code, chosen without using premise graph centrality.

sources.notes: The code map reinforces stage identity, handoff, budget and research/production authority boundaries.
Pre-dispatch stage eligibility and mostly fixed stage plan are already covered by routing, handoff, stopping and upstream-revision premises/defaults.
Explicit mutable puzzle/search state and per-solve buffer lifetime reinforce state-sufficiency, cache/lifetime and cross-invocation ownership assumptions rather than adding a new conceptual parent.
Round-robin structural sampling, session-owned work, saved-hint boundaries and resumability converge with existing diversity/allocation/persistence premises.

batches.result: Representative code-first sampling produced rediscovery rather than new parent premises, increasing confidence that recent independent code archaeology was effective.
